name: ZCA_FEED_PURGE_CONFIG_ATTRS
description: This table stores the configurations details and its value as provided by user and act as a child of zca_feed_common_configs table.

columns.name: PURGE_CONFIG_ATTR_ID
columns.description: Auto generated primary key of the table.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_DATA_TYPE
columns.description: Data type of the purge filter attribute

columns.name: FEED_TYPE
columns.description: Feed object type eg: Lead

columns.name: EVENT_OBJ_NAME
columns.description: Related object name of the parent object Eg Note

columns.name: PARENT_OBJ_NAME
columns.description: Parent object name of the feed type Eg Appointment

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: Purge filter attribute name Eg : Status

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_VALUE
columns.description: Purge filter attribute value Eg: Won

columns.name: PURGE_CONDITION
columns.description: Purge criteria filter condition . Default value AND

columns.name: SEQUENCE
columns.description: Order of the filter conditions

columns.name: OPERATOR
columns.description: Operator for the purge attributes eg: IN

columns.name: ENABLE_FOR_PURGE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag for the filter attribute to be considered for the purge filter criteria

columns.name: MANDATORY_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to make an purge filter attribute as mandatory

columns.name: VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to make an purge filter attribute to be visible in UI

columns.name: READ_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to make an purge filter attribute as non editable

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description for the attribute

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
